title: The sharp constant in the Mashreghi-Ransford inequality
summary: Let $(a_n)_{n\geq0}$ be a sequence of complex numbers, and define \[ b_n=\sum_{k=0}^n \binom{n}{k} a_k, \qquad c_n=\sum_{k=0}^n \binom{n}{k}(-1)^{n-k}a_k. \] Let $β>1$, put $α=\sqrt{β^2-1}$, and suppose that $b_n,c_n=O(β^n)$. Mashreghi and Ransford proved that \[ \limsup_{n\to\infty}\frac{|a_n|}{α^n} \leq κ\left(\limsup_{n\to\infty}\frac{|b_n|}{β^n}\right)^{\!1/2}\! \left(\limsup_{n\to\infty}\frac{|c_n|}{β^n}\right)^{\!1/2} \] with a universal constant satisfying $2/\sqrt{3} \leq κ\leq2$.
